context: M29 o4. The hand-over, with lines keyed to the Branch B flag.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Mr. Arce. You came. I can work with this. You'll have to take the stand.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I've been in a car long enough. I'll take a chair.

lines.speaker: char.nora_finch
lines.text: Two sources, a dead seaman, a lawyer and a lieutenant's boat. That's a Sunday paper.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Print page nine first, Miss Finch. That's us.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Mr. Arce. I'd heard you were sensible. Sit. What would you like to be called?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Arce. And the Corwin stays open. Forever, counsel. Notwithstanding.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Forty pages in the Corwin's 1911 boiler. Lisle's voice, going up the chimney.

lines.speaker: char.gus_wilkie
lines.text: Boiler's from 1911. I'm a priest. I do last rites.
